intent: Add published manufacturers’ catalog products as clearly labeled rotating fallback in Super price, daily and weekly homepage sections. Preserve paid API fields, paid placement priority, exclusive daily slot and durations; retain published currency and quote-only prices, deterministic Bucharest daily balanced and disjoint picks, accessible 6-second viewport-only carousels respecting focus and reduced motion. No database changes; preserve routes, fonts and configurator.

evidence: src/app/api/promotions/route.ts:78 -- return await localizedJson({ error: 'Promovările nu au putut fi încărcate.' }, { status: 503, headers: { 'Cache-Control': 'no-store' } });
findings.suggested_fix: Initialize empty catalog selections and put catalog pagination, supplier lookup and selection construction in a dedicated try/catch. Log fallback errors and return the already loaded paid fields and slot availability with empty catalog selections; retain the outer failure handling for paid queries. Add a route test where catalog or supplier loading fails after a paid placement loads successfully.
findings.title: Isolate catalog failures from paid placements
findings.why_it_matters: When any section has no paid placement, a failed catalog request now hides every successfully loaded paid placement: the optional fallback throws into the route-wide catch and returns 503. The supplier lookup has the same failure propagation. Isolating fallback loading lets paid Super price, daily and weekly placements remain available when the catalog query fails.
findings.validation_reason: With a successful paid placement and any empty paid section, newly added route.ts:48 enters catalog loading and route.ts:56 or :67 throws catalog/supplier errors into :76–78, replacing paid response fields with 503; the browser fetch consumer at PromotedOffers.tsx:23–27 rejects that response, and failure incidence was not measured.

evidence: src/components/PromotedOffers.tsx:194 --     if (!playing || hovered || !inViewport || offers.length <= position.visible) return;
findings.suggested_fix: Add a rendered PromotedOffers browser/component regression using a fixed API response and controlled time: assert no advance before intersection, one advance after six visible seconds, no further advance after exit, and observer/timer cleanup on unmount. Include focus pause and reduced-motion behavior for the newly shared carousel entry points.
findings.title: Cover viewport carousel lifecycle through the rendered component
findings.why_it_matters: The new viewport observer and interval gate determine whether all three sections rotate only while visible, but neither added test file renders PromotedOffers. Removing the viewport gate or observer cleanup would therefore leave the supplied tests green while breaking an explicit accessibility and lifecycle requirement. A rendered test with controlled intersection notifications and time can prove that entering starts rotation, leaving stops it, and unmount disconnects the observer and clears the interval.
findings.validation_reason: The new observer and viewport timer gate at PromotedOffers.tsx:153–159 and :193–197 execute when a returned section mounts with enough offers, while catalog-offers unit tests exercise only the helper and promotions integration tests assert HTTP/data behavior; an exhaustive tests/scripts text search found no rendered PromotedOffers, intersection, focus, or reduced-motion carousel coverage, and browser verification is pending.
